mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses equity discount rates through prolonged monetary accommodation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants price in sustained low-cost capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% across any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as risk premiums rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and acceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k) signals robust labor market dynamics that boost corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts below 1250 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1250 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation that erodes real corporate profits, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors demand higher risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-constrained regimes, a monthly decline in industrial production below 106.0 signals manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 106.0 during supply-constrained regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1250) and retail sales (RSAFS < 490000) signals broad-based demand weakness that depresses corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1250 and RSAFS < 490000.
